line_chains.goal: Casino exit sets up the slowest hairpin — sacrifice mid-corner speed for rotation
Treat pool chicanes + Rascasse as one complex — exit speed onto the short straight wins
Tight Rascasse hook sets up the last corner and start-finish straight

line.line_hint: Stay right on the straight, then use full track width left before turn-in

landmarks.map: Bottom-left of the map — first right off the start straight
landmarks.approach: Main straight uphill toward the harbour
landmarks.line_hint: Stay right on the straight, then use full track width left before turn-in
landmarks.brake_cue: Brake at the 100m board while the wall still runs straight ahead
landmarks.apex_cue: Tight right at the bottom of the hill; stay off the sausage kerb
landmarks.exit_cue: Short climb on full throttle toward Beau Rivage

line.compromise_note: A slightly tighter Casino mid-corner is OK if it rotates the car for the hairpin

landmarks.map: Top-left sweep past the casino hairpin area
landmarks.brake_cue: Brake as the hotel facade fills your left peripheral vision
landmarks.apex_cue: Right at the casino — use all the road on the inside
landmarks.exit_cue: Feed throttle once the front bites toward Mirabeau

line.line_hint: Use the full left side of the track on approach — do not turn in early

landmarks.map: Tightest loop on the left side of the map
landmarks.line_hint: Use the full left side of the track on approach — do not turn in early
landmarks.brake_cue: Hard brake when the guard rail on your right opens up
landmarks.apex_cue: Slowest point of the lap — hairpin apex at the hotel
landmarks.exit_cue: Patience on throttle until the car is straight for Portier

line.grip_note: Bumps and kerb rubber — clip inside kerb for grip, straighten for harbour

landmarks.map: Right-hand kink where the long bottom curve meets the harbour
landmarks.approach: Blind exit from the tunnel onto the waterfront
landmarks.brake_cue: Brake when daylight opens and the chicane kerbs appear
landmarks.apex_cue: Clip the inside kerb, avoid hopping the sausage
landmarks.exit_cue: Flat through Tabac approach once the rear settles

line.compromise_note: Miss the ideal first apex if it opens a cleaner second chicane and Rascasse entry
line.grip_note: Kerb rubber and painted lines — stay on the rubber, not the geometric wide arc
line.line_hint: Rhythm through both chicanes — sacrifice pool 1 if pool 2 and Rascasse improve

landmarks.map: Top-right double wiggle — two quick left-right kinks
landmarks.approach: Fast left at Tabac with the harbour on your right
landmarks.brake_cue: Hard brake as the first blue pool structure passes on your left
landmarks.apex_cue: Rhythm through both chicanes — don't fight the second kerb
landmarks.exit_cue: Short harbour straight; the tight right hook of Rascasse is next

line.grip_note: Blind left on rubber — narrow line on the racing groove is faster than opening up

landmarks.map: Fast left kink between the harbour straight and the pool chicanes
landmarks.approach: Flat out along the harbour wall after the tunnel section
landmarks.brake_cue: No brake — blind left, trust the line on the rubber
landmarks.apex_cue: Quick left with barriers close on both sides
landmarks.exit_cue: Open throttle toward the first Swimming Pool board

line.grip_note: Half a metre too wide and the grip disappears — stay on the inside rubber
line.line_hint: Full width on the harbour straight, then commit to the tight inside hook on rubber

landmarks.map: Sharp right hook after the pool wiggle — pit-entry notch on the inside
landmarks.approach: Harbour straight right after the second pool chicane
landmarks.line_hint: Use the full width of the harbour straight before the tight right hook
landmarks.brake_cue: Brake when the second pool kerb is behind you and the tight right opens ahead
landmarks.apex_cue: Tightest right in sector 3 — pit wall on your inside, ~120 km/h
landmarks.exit_cue: Throttle once the car points at the short straight to the final corner

landmarks.map: Last sharp right before the bottom start straight on the map
landmarks.approach: Tiny straight after Rascasse — harbour wall on your left
landmarks.brake_cue: Light brake as the start-finish gantry comes into view ahead-left
landmarks.apex_cue: Last right onto the straight — touch inside, open for the wall exit
landmarks.exit_cue: Full throttle once the steering unwinds toward Sainte Devote
